brief: ChatGPT's instructions for the remaining A2.3 work, 7 October 2026, sections 3 to 6

population.rule: A2.3a's eligibility: both inventory views materialized and all four view/format documents rendered in the accepted A2.2d bundle

excluded.what: the 32 parents of the A2.3a pilot (also A2.3c's), recomputed with A2.3a's own salt and count

selection.rule: sort the remaining parent IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8(salt + LF + parent ID), ascending, ties by parent ID; take the first 256
selection.list_hash_rule: SHA-256 of the selected IDs in selection order, each followed by one LF

codes.rule: per parent and inventory view: sort the retained object IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8(salt + LF + parent ID + LF + view + LF + object ID), ties by object ID; the k-th object gets the k-th letter of A..J

list_order.rule: per parent and inventory view: the choices list shows the retained objects sorted by SHA-256 of UTF-8(salt + LF + parent ID + LF + view + LF + object ID), ties by object ID; [K, ASK] last

permutation_inputs: parent ID, inventory view and object IDs only: never the model, the format or any annotation
request_order: selection rank, then view (full_inventory, source_known_nyu), then format (coordinates_v2, coordinates_relations_v2)

qwen2.5-7b-instruct.loader: its own acquired folder (acquisition.json naming the pinned revision), including tokenizer.json
